summary: Tony puts people at ease, so they feel relaxed and confident in front of the camera, even those who usually dislike being photographed.
The photos are beautiful and natural, catching the little moments couples didn't know were happening.
Clear, friendly communication from the first message to the final gallery, with the practice shoot often mentioned as the key to a relaxed wedding day.

reviews.name: Josh Stewart
reviews.text: We used Tony (Moments in Light) for our wedding and he was absolutely amazing. He not only took amazing photos of our day but was an absolute pleasure to work with. He was readily available for any questions we had, was so organised and made everything so easy for us. If you're looking for a photographer, I couldn't recommend Tony any higher - if I could, I would!

reviews.reply:
Josh and Paul, thank you so much for this lovely review. It was a real privilege to photograph your wedding at Settlers Country Manor. It's one of my favourite wedding venues in West Auckland, and the gardens and golden light out in Waimauku were the perfect backdrop for the two of you.

Thank you as well for the kind words about the planning side. I want my couples to feel relaxed and looked after well before the day itself, so I'm so glad the process felt easy for you both. Your day was full of laughter and real moments, and I loved telling your story through the photos.

I hope you enjoy your gallery for many years to come. Congratulations again, and thank you for trusting Moments in Light with your wedding photography.

Tony

reviews.name: Sofia Karsberg
reviews.text:
Tony shot our wedding and was both a brilliant and professional photographer as well as an easy going and comfortable guide to the day. With so much going on in every moment he seemed to always know where to be to capture the special little moments that we didn’t even realize were happening ourselves.

The best part of having him around (other than the amazing photos) was that he just knew what everyone needed to be doing and how to do it. Obviously, we spent months planning our special day but there were always little moments where we weren’t entirely sure what to do and Tony, with his experience, was great at making those little suggestions which made the special moments that we will cherish the most. That’s not something we really thought we would be getting from a photographer but just made the whole experience so seamless and easy – it was like having a wedding coach and photographer in one!

Having a practice shoot was not something we were really expecting to do with a photographer but was worth its weight in gold! We got to practice poses, talk about what we did and didn’t like and see what worked for us. This meant that on the day we could capture a ton of great photos without eating into the rest of the wedding schedule. We also ended up with another set of great pictures of us!

Could not wish for a better experience! Thoroughly recommended!

Thank you so much for these very generous words. It truly means the world to me to hear that the effort goes noticed, that the images speak to people and that the love and attention I put into planning is worthwhile.

This was such an amazing day, the care and attention you put into the planning really showed and I LOVE the results.

reviews.name: Rebecca Lindner
reviews.text: Moments in light is a fantastic photographer to work with. Tony was receptive to all feedback from our practice shoot and brought that into our wedding day. Despite the rain he got some fantastic photos that I will absolutely treasure forever. Because of the rain we got extra shots we didn't originally have time for. Tony is amazing to work with and absolutely worth it! He captured the raw and candid essence of our special day and delivered some incredible photos that captured our love and celebration. He doesn't have a photo or time limit like some other photographers and that meant he was there for us the whole day and we got all of the beautiful photos he took for us. I barely noticed him during the more intimate moments but seeing the photos afterwards he absolutely captured the raw emotions in those moments.
reviews.reply: Thank you so much for your kind words. I consider myself very lucky to have spent the day with you all. I really enjoyed the day and yes despite the weather we got great pics. Bridgewater estate is such a lovely venue. I particularly enjoyed just hanging with you and your close family members at the end of the night. Thank you for making me feel like a friend.

reviews.name: emma stokes
reviews.text:

Everyone felt at ease which can be hard to do when getting formal wedding photos! All our specific special moments were caught and the dance floor shots were amazing showing just how great our party was! I cannot recommend moments in light highly enough, Tony was easy to work with and very understanding from the start to the end, he was the
perfect mix of professional and fun!
